title: New Heavens and New Earth
definition: The New Heavens and New Earth is the final renewed creation where God dwells with His redeemed people forever in righteousness, joy, and peace.
summary: God will make all things new and dwell forever with His redeemed people.
christFocus: Jesus returns as King to complete redemption, raise His people, judge evil, and bring them into the fullness of new creation life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The final hope of Scripture is not a vague spiritual existence but God's renewed creation. The New Heavens and New Earth will be the home of righteousness, where God dwells with His people and every effect of sin is removed.

There will be no more death, mourning, crying, or pain. The curse will be gone. God's servants will worship Him, see His face, and reign with Him.

This hope is secured by Christ. His resurrection is the beginning of new creation, and His return will bring the fullness of restoration.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often think Christian hope is only about leaving earth behind. New Heavens and New Earth matters because it shows God's plan to redeem, restore, and renew creation itself.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Let the promise of new creation give courage in suffering and purpose in obedience. Live now as a citizen of the coming kingdom, pursuing holiness, hope, worship, and mission.
